FAQ

Common questions.

Do I need to know how to code?
No, but you'll need Python installed to run the script, and it's smart to test it on a copy of your files first.
What can't it do?
It's built for small, single-purpose scripts. Big jobs — full applications, databases, connecting to other apps or websites — are outside this tool.
Is it safe to run?
Scripts are written to ask before anything that can't be undone. Read what it does, and try it on a copy of your files first.
Is what I enter stored?
No. Your description is used to write the script and isn't kept afterward. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Workflow Builder is part of Workblox Personal. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $10/mo for 1–2 tools, $15/mo for 3–4 tools, or $20/mo for 5–7 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
